units.literal: His father Tong, dwelling in Dunhua Lane in Luoyang, dredged a well and found an ancient tripod; the inscription read: “In spring, second month, first year of Huangchu of Wei, craftsman Ji Qian.”

units.zh: 丙寅，以西面行營馬軍都指揮使、檢校太保、鄭州刺史、充本州防禦使王彥章為檢校太傅。
units.en: On bingyin, Wang Yanzhang, Western Line horse commander, honorary Grand Guardian, and Zheng prefect and defense commissioner, was promoted to honorary Grand Mentor.
units.literal: On bingyin, Western Line camp horse commander, honorary Grand Guardian, Zheng prefect, and Zheng defense commissioner Wang Yanzhang was made honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 十二月，晉王自太原復至魏州。
units.en: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin returned from Taiyuan to Weizhou.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin came again from Taiyuan to Weizhou.

units.zh: 子樞，字紀聖，咸通十二年登進士第。
units.en: His son Shu, courtesy name Jisheng, passed the jinshi examination in Xiantong 12 (871).
units.literal: His son Shu, courtesy name Jisheng, in the twelfth year of Xiantong passed the jinshi examination.

units.zh: 樞因盜而振，盜憎而亡，宜哉！
units.en: Shu rose through the rebel's favor, and when the rebel turned against him he perished—as was only fitting!
units.literal: Shu rose through the bandit, the bandit hated him and he perished—fitting indeed!

units.zh: 大學士王鐸深知之，鐸罷相失職，樞亦久之不調。
units.en: Grand Academician Wang Duo thought highly of him. When Duo lost the chief ministry and fell from power, Shu too went long without a new appointment.
units.literal: Grand Academician Wang Duo deeply knew him; when Duo was removed from the chief ministry and lost his post, Shu also for a long time received no transfer.

units.zh: 大順中，緯以用兵無功貶官，樞坐累為右庶子，尋出為歙州刺史。
units.en: In the Dashun era Kong Wei was demoted for military failure. Shu was implicated and made right guardian of the heir apparent, then sent out as prefect of She.
units.literal: In Dazhun Wei was demoted for using troops without merit; Shu was implicated and made Right Guardian of the Heir Apparent, soon sent out as Prefect of She.

units.zh: 初，樞自歙州罷郡歸朝，路經大梁，時硃全忠兵威已振，樞以兄事之，全忠由是重之。
units.en: Earlier, when Shu left his post at She and returned to court, his route took him through Daliang. Zhu Quanzhong's military power was already formidable, and Shu treated him with the deference due an elder brother—whereupon Quanzhong came to esteem him.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shu from She prefecture left his command and returned to court, his route passed through Daliang; at the time Zhu Quanzhong's military prestige was already rising; Shu treated him as an elder brother, and Quanzhong therefore valued him.

units.zh: 六月十一日，行及滑州，全忠遣人殺之於白馬驛，投屍於河，時年六十五。
units.en: On the eleventh day of the sixth month, when he reached Hua prefecture on the Yellow River on his way into exile, Quanzhong sent men to kill him at Baima Post and throw his body into the river. He was sixty-five years old.
units.literal: On the eleventh day of the sixth month, when his journey reached Hua prefecture, Quanzhong sent men to kill him at Baima Post, threw the corpse into the river—he was sixty-five years of age.

units.zh: 俄而全忠聞樞言，謂賓佐曰：「吾常以裴十四器識真純，不入浮薄之伍，觀此議論，本態露矣。」
units.en: When Quanzhong heard of Shu's words he told his staff, 'I always thought Pei the Fourteenth was genuinely upright and would never join the frivolous crowd—but this opinion shows his true colors.'
units.literal: Soon Quanzhong heard Shu's words and said to his guests and aides: 'I always considered Pei the Fourteenth's capacity and insight truly pure, not entering the ranks of the frivolous and shallow—viewing this discussion, his true nature is revealed.'

units.zh: 宰相杜審權出鎮河中，辟為從事，得秘書省校書郎，再遷藍田尉。
units.en: When Chief Minister Du Shenquan went out to command Hezhong, he recruited Shu as administrative aide. Shu was appointed collator in the Secretariat and later promoted twice to magistrate of Lantian.
units.literal: Chief Minister Du Shenquan went out to garrison Hezhong and recruited him as administrative aide; he obtained Collator in the Secretariat and was twice transferred to Magistrate of Lantian.

units.zh: 龍紀初，擢拜給事中，改京兆尹。
units.en: At the beginning of the Longji era he was promoted to drafting attendant and then made metropolitan prefect.
units.literal: At the beginning of Longji he was promoted and appointed Drafting Attendant, then changed to Metropolitan Prefect.

units.zh: 未幾，換戶部侍郎、同平章事。
units.en: Before long he was transferred to vice minister of revenue and appointed a chief minister.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue and made a chief minister (tong pingzhangshi).

units.zh: 制出，硃全忠保薦之，言樞有經世才，不可棄之嶺表，尋復拜門下侍郎，監修國史，累兼吏部尚書，判度支。
units.en: When the appointment was issued, Zhu Quanzhong intervened on his behalf, declaring that Shu possessed talent to govern the realm and should not be banished to the far south. Shu was soon made vice director of the Chancellery, put in charge of compiling the national history, and eventually also minister of personnel with charge of revenue.
units.literal: When the appointment was issued, Zhu Quanzhong recommended and protected him, saying Shu had talent to order the age and could not be abandoned to the southern ranges; soon he was again appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery, supervised compilation of the national history, repeatedly held concurrently Minister of Personnel, and decided revenue affairs.

units.zh: 從昭宗遷洛陽，駐蹕陜州，進右僕射、弘文館大學士、太清宮使，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使。
units.en: He accompanied Emperor Zhaozong to Luoyang and, when the court halted at Shan, was promoted to right vice director, grand academician of the Hongwen Hall, commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, and transport commissioner for salt and iron across all circuits.
units.literal: He followed Zhaozong in moving to Luoyang, halted at Shan prefecture, was advanced to Right Vice Director, Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall, Commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, and served as Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner of all circuits.

units.zh: 直弘文館。
units.en: He served on duty at the Hongwen Hall.
units.literal: He served on duty at the Hongwen Hall.

units.zh: 中和初，王鐸復見用，以舊恩徙為鄭滑掌書記、檢校司封郎中，賜金紫，入朝歷兵、吏二員外郎。
units.en: Early in the Zhonghe era Wang Duo returned to power. Out of old friendship Shu was made secretary to the Zheng-Hua command and investigating director in the Bureau of Enfeoffments, granted the gold-and-purple insignia, and after returning to court served as vice director in the ministries of War and Personnel.
units.literal: At the beginning of Zhonghe Wang Duo was again employed; because of old grace he was transferred to Secretary of Zheng and Hua, Investigating Director of the Bureau of Enfeoffments, granted gold and purple, entered court and passed through Vice Director in the Ministries of War and Personnel.

units.zh: 從僖宗幸蜀，中丞李煥奏為殿中侍御史，遷起居郎。
units.en: He accompanied Emperor Xizong to Shu. Vice censor-in-chief Li Huan recommended him as attending censor in the palace, and he was promoted to diarist.
units.literal: He followed Xizong to Shu; Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Huan memorialized him as Attending Censor in the Palace, and he was transferred to Diarist.

units.zh: 宰相孔緯尤深獎遇。
units.en: Chief Minister Kong Wei especially favored and promoted him.
units.literal: Chief Minister Kong Wei especially deeply rewarded and favored him.

units.zh: 乾寧初，入為右散騎常侍，從昭宗幸華州，為汴州宣諭使。
units.en: Early in the Qianning era he was recalled as right regular attendant of the cavalry, accompanied Emperor Zhaozong to Hua, and was appointed commissioner to proclaim the court's will at Bian.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianning he entered as Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, followed Zhaozong to Hua prefecture, and served as Proclamation and Consolation Commissioner to Bian.

units.zh: 及樞傳詔，全忠皆稟朝旨，獻奉相繼，昭宗甚悅，遷兵部侍郎。
units.en: When Shu delivered the imperial edict, Quanzhong obeyed the court's every instruction and sent tribute in unbroken succession. Emperor Zhaozong was greatly pleased and promoted Shu to vice minister of war.
units.literal: When Shu transmitted the edict, Quanzhong all followed court intent; tribute and offerings followed in succession; Zhaozong was very pleased and transferred him to Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 時崔胤專政，亦倚全忠，二人因是相結，改樞吏部侍郎。
units.en: Cui Yin was then dominant at court and also relied on Quanzhong. The two formed an alliance, and Shu was made vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: At the time Cui Yin monopolized government and also relied on Quanzhong; the two therefore joined together and changed Shu to Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 其年冬，昭宗幸華州，崔胤貶官，樞亦為工部尚書。
units.en: That winter Emperor Zhaozong went to Hua. When Cui Yin was demoted, Shu was made minister of works.
units.literal: That winter Zhaozong went to Hua prefecture; Cui Yin was demoted, and Shu also became Minister of Works.

units.zh: 天子自岐下還宮，以樞檢校右僕射、同平章事，出為廣南節度使。
units.en: When the emperor returned to the capital from Qi, Shu was made investigating right vice director and chief minister, then sent out as military commissioner of Guangnan.
units.literal: When the Son of Heaven returned to the palace from below Qi, Shu was made Investigating Right Vice Director and Concurrent Regular Attendant, and sent out as Military Commissioner of Guangnan.

units.zh: 哀帝初嗣位，柳璨用事，全忠嘗奏用牙將張廷範為太常卿，諸相議，樞曰：「廷範勛臣，幸有方鎮節鉞之命，何藉樂卿？
units.en: When Emperor Aidi first took the throne, Liu Can was in power. Quanzhong once recommended his military officer Zhang Tingfan as director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. The chief ministers deliberated, and Shu said, 'Tingfan is a meritorious officer who may yet receive a regional command—why does he need the directorship of the Court of Sacrifices?
units.literal: When Aidi first succeeded to the throne, Liu Can held power; Quanzhong once memorialized to employ his military officer Zhang Tingfan as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the chief ministers discussed it, and Shu said: 'Tingfan is a meritorious minister—fortunately he may receive a regional command with military commission; what need has he of the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices?

units.zh: 恐非元帥梁王之旨。」
units.en: I fear this is not what the Prince of Liang, our commander-in-chief, intends.'
units.literal: I fear this is not the intent of the Marshal, King of Liang.'

units.zh: 乃持之不下。
units.en: He therefore withheld the appointment and would not issue it.
units.literal: He therefore held it and did not issue it.

units.zh: 柳璨聞全忠言，尋希旨罷樞相位，和陵祔享，拜尚書左僕射。
units.en: Liu Can, hearing Quanzhong's anger, soon had Shu removed from the chief ministry in accord with his wishes. At the joint offering at He Mausoleum Shu was made left vice director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Liu Can heard Quanzhong's words and soon, to suit the intent, removed Shu from the chief-minister position; at the joint offering at He Mausoleum he was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 五月，責授朝散大夫、登州刺史，尋再貶瀧州司戶。
units.en: In the fifth month he was demoted to grand master of palace leisure and prefect of Deng, then soon further demoted to registrar of Long prefecture.
units.literal: In the fifth month he was punished and appointed Grand Master of Palace Leisure and Prefect of Deng, soon again demoted to Registrar of Long prefecture.

units.zh: 崔胤誅，以全忠素厚，相位如故。
units.en: After Cui Yin was executed, Shu retained his chief ministry unchanged, thanks to his long-standing ties with Quanzhong.
units.literal: When Cui Yin was executed, because Quanzhong had long been close his chief-minister position remained as before.

units.zh: 十年六月，潞帥李抱真卒，又以謜領昭義節度大使、澤潞邢洺名磁觀察等使，以潞將王虔休為潞府司馬、知留後。
units.en: In the sixth month of the tenth year, Li Baozhen, commander of Lu, died; Song was again appointed military commissioner of Zhaoyi and observation commissioner for Ze, Lu, Xing, Ming, Ci, and related prefectures, with the Lu general Wang Qianxiu as Lu prefecture vice commander and acting deputy commissioner.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, the Lu commander Li Baozhen died; Song was again made military commissioner of Zhaoyi and observation commissioner for Ze, Lu, Xing, Ming, Ci, and other prefectures; the Lu general Wang Qianxiu was made Lu prefecture vice commander and acting deputy commissioner.

units.zh: 從朱珍討徐州，撥豐縣，敗時溥於吳康，得其輜重，加檢校刑部尚書。
units.en: At Xuzhou he took Feng, beat Shi Pu at Wukang, and became honorary Minister of Punishments.
units.literal: Following Zhu Zhen to attack Xuzhou he took Feng county, defeated Shi Pu at Wukang, obtained his baggage train, and was added honorary Minister of Punishments.

units.zh: 及佐朱珍討時溥，寨於豐、蕭之間，歸厚乘徐壘如行坦途，甚為諸將歎伏。
units.en: Besieging Shi Pu he crossed Xu walls as if on flat ground.
units.literal: When aiding Zhu Zhen against Shi Pu he stockaded between Feng and Xiao; Guihou crossed Xu ramparts as if on level road—generals deeply sighed in admiration.
